about: github's decision table (the P3 procedure). The operations the applications call (journeys/demand.json: the platform's own callers — the World's Actions runner and the catalog's release walk — and Open Autonomy's kit, setup, platform and Team editor, the Volter Harness board and installer, the Volter Editor, Workbench's store, Twin and its on-call recipe, Volter identity's twin, Dub, Rallly, Twenty's site; LibreChat's, Postiz's and Twenty's opt-in sign-ins and LibreChat's skill sync are journeys/demand.json's optional), and the eight the life sends to make the state they read (a webhook and its deliveries, a commit status, a milestone, a release with its assets, an advisory published). GraphQL's root fields are decided one by one, each served only as the demand asks. Code is a git repository of the World (ctx.git), pushed and cloned over smart HTTP; a ruleset's rules hold on pushes, contents commits and merges. Every other operation of a declared resource is the manifest's unmodeled, and every operation of an undeclared one answers GitHub's Not Found (the gap).
